description: This file implements a PHP class library for interacting with Oracle databases via OCI8, providing connection handling, query execution, metadata retrieval, and LOB (Large Object) management for the ADODB abstraction layer.

classes.name: ADODB_oci8
classes.description: Handles Oracle OCI8 database connections and queries with methods to connect, execute SQL, manage transactions, retrieve metadata, and handle large objects.

classes.name: ADORecordset_oci8
classes.description: Represents a recordset retrieved from Oracle via OCI8, providing data fetching, field metadata, and cursor management.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_ext_oci8
classes.description: An extension of the OCI8 recordset with modified MoveNext behavior.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieve metadata about table columns in Oracle.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to Oracle database with various modes.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Fetches server version and compatibility info from Oracle.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last operation.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Retrieves last error message from OCI8 operations.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Generates SQL string for date formatting.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes an SQL statement with optional parameter binding.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement for execution.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds a PHP variable to a SQL statement placeholder with optionalLOB handling.

methods.name: Parameter
methods.description: Creates parameter placeholder for prepared statements.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the database connection and frees resources.
